####################################################################################################
Purpose: This script defines the inclusion or exclusion of studies into the data frame for each
pathogen based on the data and checks with the protocol metadata.

Output:
- `stu_vaccconc.rds`: Data frame containing GSK vaccine concentrations per study, RCT group, and 
country.
- `stu_included_perpat.rds`: Data frame containing GSK studies included per pathogen.
####################################################################################################

# Load packages, themes, directories, and functions
```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("00_pck.R")
```

# Load data
```{r}
# Load the data frame of included studies
stu_included <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$processed}/stu_included.rds")) %>% 
  filter(included == TRUE)
# Load data frames containing vaccine and serology names from included studies
stu_vaccines <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$processed}/stu_tidynames_vaccines.rds"))
stu_seronames <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$processed}/stu_tidynames_seronames.rds"))
# Load metadata sourced from protocols
stu_meta_pro <-readRDS(glue("{dirs$processed}/stu_meta_pro.rds")) %>%
  filter(study %in% stu_included$study)
```

# Define if the studies are included per pathogen according to vaccination
```{r}
stu_perpat_included <- stu_vaccines %>%
  select(study, vaccine_tidy) %>%
  # Filter out cases with no vaccination
  filter(!is.na(vaccine_tidy) & vaccine_tidy != "placebo") %>%
  # Standardize pathogen names
  separate_longer_delim(vaccine_tidy, delim = "_") %>%
  mutate(pat = case_when(
    vaccine_tidy %in% c("dtpa", "dtpw") ~ "dipht_tetan_pertu",
    vaccine_tidy %in% c("mmr") ~ "measl_mumps_rubel",
    .default = vaccine_tidy
  )) %>%
  separate_longer_delim(pat, delim = "_") %>%
  mutate(pat = case_when(
    str_detect(pat, "strep") ~ "strep", 
    str_detect(pat, "ipv|opv") ~ "polio", 
    str_detect(pat, "measl") ~ "measl", 
    .default = pat,
  )) %>%
  distinct(study, pat)
```

# Exclusions per pathogen: Serology measurements and previous vaccinations =========================

# 1. Identify studies missing serology measurements per pathogen (the study planned vaccination but 
# not ab measurements)
# Result: 84 study-pathogen pairs excluded
```{r}
exclusions_perpat <- list()
# Identify studies with immunogenicity measurements
exclusions_perpat$sero <- stu_seronames %>%
  select(study, seroname_tidy) %>%
  # Filter out seronames not related to vaccination
  filter(!(seroname_tidy %in% c(
    "anti_protd", "anti_protply", "scr_saureus", "scr_spyogenes", "scr_paeruginosa", "scr_hiv", 
    "scr_spneumoniae", "scr_mcatarrhalis", "scr_cd4cellsperc", "scr_cd4cellsconc", "anti_hiv",
    "anti_rota_iga_rix", "anti_rota_igg", "anti_rota_igtot", "anti_hbv_core")) & 
      !is.na(seroname_tidy)) %>%
  # Tidy up pathogen names
  mutate(pat = case_when(
    str_detect(seroname_tidy, "strep") ~ "strep", 
    str_detect(seroname_tidy, "polio") ~ "polio", 
    str_detect(seroname_tidy, "pertu") ~ "pertu",
    str_detect(seroname_tidy, "rota") ~ "rota", 
    str_detect(seroname_tidy, "men") ~ "men", 
    str_detect(seroname_tidy, "hbv") ~ "hbv", 
    .default = seroname_tidy,),
    pat = str_remove(pat, "anti_")) %>%
  # Define that serology was measured
  distinct(study, pat) %>%
  mutate(seroname = TRUE)

# Exclude studies that did not measure serology
stu_perpat_included <- stu_perpat_included %>%
  left_join(exclusions_perpat$sero, by = join_by(study, pat)) %>%
  mutate(seroname = replace_na(seroname, FALSE))

filter(stu_perpat_included, seroname == FALSE)
```

# 2. Identify studies permissive of previous routine vaccination per pathogen (the study planned 
# vaccination and ab measurements but allowed previous vaccinations)
# Result: 48 study-pathogen pairs excluded
```{r}
exclusions_perpat$pri <- stu_meta_pro %>%
  select(study, inclusion_criteria) %>%
  filter(str_detect(inclusion_criteria, "F")) %>%
  mutate(inclusion_criteria = str_remove_all(inclusion_criteria, "F |\\(|\\)")) %>%
  separate_longer_delim(inclusion_criteria, delim = "_") %>%
  distinct() %>%
  # Studies where HBV vaccination is obligatory at birth need redefinition
  rename(pat = inclusion_criteria) %>%
  mutate(inclusion_criteria = case_when(pat == "hbv birth" ~ "birth", .default = "excluded"),
         pat = case_when(pat == "hbv birth" ~ "hbv", .default = pat)) 

# Exclude studies based on inclusion criteria
stu_perpat_included <- stu_perpat_included %>%
  left_join(exclusions_perpat$pri, by = join_by(study, pat)) %>%
  mutate(inclusion_criteria = replace_na(inclusion_criteria, "included"))

filter(stu_perpat_included, inclusion_criteria == "excluded")
```

# Define excluded studies and save data frame per pathogen 
# Result: 545 study-pathogen combinations included 
```{r}
stu_perpat_included <- stu_perpat_included %>%
  mutate(included = case_when(
    seroname == TRUE & inclusion_criteria != "excluded" ~ TRUE,
    .default = FALSE)) %>%
  arrange(study)

filter(stu_perpat_included, included == TRUE)

saveRDS(stu_perpat_included, file = glue("{dirs$processed}/stu_included_perpat.rds"))
```

# Checks for inclusion/exclusion consistency -------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
# Check if there are studies excluded from all pathogen groups (None found)
stu_perpat_included %>%
  group_by(study) %>%
  filter(all(included == FALSE))

# Check if there are studies with serology but no vaccination (1 found)
exclusions_perpat$sero %>%
  left_join(stu_perpat_included, by = join_by(study, pat, seroname)) %>%
  filter(is.na(inclusion_criteria != "included"))
# Note: Study 347414-029 measured antibodies for DTP_HBV but is only included for MMR because the 
# primary study does not match PID
```

# Check per pathogen exclusions based on protocol metadata compared to exclusions based on data 
```{r}
stu_meta_perpat <- stu_meta_pro %>%
  select(study, exclusion, reason) %>%
  filter(str_detect(exclusion, "Excluded for pp")) %>%
  separate_longer_delim(reason, delim = ", ") %>%
  mutate(pat = str_extract(reason, "\\(.*?\\)"),
         pat = str_remove_all(pat, "\\(|\\)")) %>%
  separate_longer_delim(pat, delim = "_") %>%
  # Separate exclusions per pathogen (pp) from for rctg
  mutate(
    exclusion = str_remove_all(exclusion, "\\(.*?\\)"),
    exclusion = case_when(
      exclusion == "Excluded for pp , Excluded for rctg" & str_detect(reason, "Rctg") ~ 
        "Excluded for rctg",
      exclusion == "Excluded for pp , Excluded for rctg" & !str_detect(reason, "Rctg") ~ 
        "Excluded for pp",
      .default = exclusion),
    exclusion = trimws(exclusion)) %>%
  filter(exclusion == "Excluded for pp")

# Compare with protocol exclusions
# Studies excluded in the protocol but not in the data (172 pairs found due to method, baseline, and 
# vac_conc)
left_join(stu_perpat_included, stu_meta_perpat, by = join_by(study, pat)) %>%
  filter(included == TRUE, !is.na(reason)) %>%
  group_by(reason) %>%
  summarise(tot = n())

# Studies excluded in the data but not in the protocol (None found)
left_join(stu_perpat_included, stu_meta_perpat, by = join_by(study, pat)) %>%
  filter(included == FALSE, is.na(reason))
```

# Cross-check data-driven vaccination status with protocol records 
```{r}
stu_meta_pro_checks <- list()
stu_meta_pro_checks$vaccine <- stu_meta_pro %>%
  select(study, starts_with("pat")) %>%
  pivot_longer(starts_with("pat"), names_to = "pat", values_to = "vaccine_pro") %>%
  mutate(pat = str_remove(pat, "pat_")) %>%
  mutate(vaccine_pro = as.logical(vaccine_pro)) %>%
  left_join(select(stu_perpat_included, study, pat, included) %>%
              mutate(vaccine_dat = TRUE), by = join_by(study, pat)) %>%
  mutate(vaccine_dat = replace_na(vaccine_dat, FALSE))

# Check if there are vaccines indicated in the protocol but not reflected in the data
filter(stu_meta_pro_checks$vaccine, vaccine_pro == TRUE & vaccine_dat == FALSE)
# Note: Study 347414-017 and 347414-029 involve main-follow-up relationships, but PIDs do not match. 
# Primary vaccination for DTP, MEN, Hib, Strep is in 347414-017, and MMR is in -029.

# Check if there are vaccines recorded in the data but not mentioned in the protocol (None found)
filter(stu_meta_pro_checks$vaccine, vaccine_pro == FALSE & vaccine_dat == TRUE)
```
